department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Financial support of Rs 6000 per year to small and marginal farmer families across India.
eligibility_text: Landholding small & marginal farmers aged 18 to 75 with annual household income up to 3 Lakhs.
benefits: Rs 6000 per year paid in 3 equal installments of Rs 2000 directly to bank accounts.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing scheme to provide pucca houses to eligible urban households with interest subsidies.
eligibility_text: Urban citizens aged 21-70 with annual family income up to 6 Lakhs.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans up to Rs 2.67 Lakhs.

department: Ministry of Finance
description: Collateral-free micro loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs for non-corporate micro enterprises.
eligibility_text: Non-corporate non-farm small micro enterprises owned by Indian citizens aged 18-65.
benefits: Loans under Shishu (up to 50k) Kishor (up to 5L) and Tarun (up to 10L).

department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage.
eligibility_text: SC category students enrolled in post-matric courses with family income below 2.5 Lakhs.
benefits: Full tuition fee coverage plus monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 1350/month.

department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Small savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children to build corpus for education and marriage.
eligibility_text: Girl children below 10 years of age resident in India.
benefits: High interest rate of 8.2% p.a. with tax exemption under Section 80C.

department: Department of Women and Child Development MP
description: Monthly financial assistance to women in Madhya Pradesh to foster economic independence.
eligibility_text: Married/widowed women in MP aged 21-60 with annual family income up to 2.5 Lakhs.
benefits: Rs 1250 directly transferred to beneficiary bank account every month.

department: Department of Women Development & Social Welfare WB
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme to improve status of adolescent girls and encourage education.
eligibility_text: Unmarried girls aged 13-19 studying in recognized institutions with income up to 1.2 Lakhs.
benefits: Annual grant of Rs 1000 plus one-time grant of Rs 25,000 on reaching 18 years.

department: Agriculture Department Telangana
description: Investment support scheme for agriculture and horticulture crops per season.
eligibility_text: Farmer landowners in Telangana owning agricultural land.
benefits: Rs 10000 per acre per year for two crop seasons.

department: Women and Child Development Department MH
description: Financial support for the health and education of girl child in Maharashtra.
eligibility_text: Girl child born in Maharashtra family with annual income up to 7.5 Lakhs.
benefits: Rs 50000 deposited in bank account in the name of girl child.

department: Department of Social Welfare TN
description: Rights grant for women heads of households in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Women household heads aged 21-65 in Tamil Nadu with family income below 2.5 Lakhs.
benefits: Rs 1000 per month direct benefit transfer.

department: Department of Employment Karnataka
description: Unemployment stipend for fresh graduates and diploma holders residing in Karnataka.
eligibility_text: Unemployed graduates/diploma holders passed out in recent academic year residing in Karnataka.
benefits: Rs 3000/month for degree graduates and Rs 1500/month for diploma holders up to 2 years.

department: Department of Women and Child Development Odisha
description: Financial empowerment scheme providing vouchers to women in Odisha.
eligibility_text: Women citizens of Odisha aged 21 to 60 years.
benefits: Rs 5000 per installment twice a year totaling Rs 50,000 over 5 years.

department: Ministry of Micro Small & Medium Enterprises
description: Comprehensive support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople across India.
eligibility_text: Artisans working with hands & tools in 18 traditional trades aged 18+.
benefits: Collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs 3 Lakhs at 5% interest rate + Rs 15,000 tool kit incentive.

scheme_name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) Old Age Pension
department: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Monthly pension support for senior citizens belonging to below poverty line households.
eligibility_text: BPL senior citizens aged 60 years and above.
benefits: Rs 1000 to Rs 1500 monthly pension assistance depending on age tier.

department: Department of Micro Small & Medium Enterprises UP
description: Margin money subsidy scheme for educated unemployed youth in Uttar Pradesh to set up business.
eligibility_text: Youth aged 18-45 residing in UP with minimum 8th class pass qualification.
benefits: Up to 25% project cost subsidy (max Rs 6.25 Lakhs) for setting up micro enterprise.

department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Financial assistance for ST students pursuing post-secondary education.
eligibility_text: ST category students with family annual income up to 2.5 Lakhs enrolled in recognized colleges.
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees and book bank allowance.

department: Ministry of Finance
description: Bank loans between 10 Lakhs and 1 Crore to SC ST and Women borrowers for greenfield enterprise.
eligibility_text: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield manufacturing/trading ventures.
benefits: Loans from 10 Lakhs to 1 Crore with minimal margin money requirement.

department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit program offering cash incentive for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
eligibility_text: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19-45 for first live birth.
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs 5000 in three installments for health & nutrition support.

department: Ministry of Railways
description: Scheme for modernization and master planning of railway stations across the country.
eligibility_text: All citizens and commuters using Indian Railways infrastructure.
benefits: Upgraded passenger amenities, accessible stations, and modern waiting halls.

department: Education Department Gujarat
description: Financial assistance for higher education of bright students in Gujarat.
eligibility_text: Students securing 80+ percentile in 10th/12th standard with family income up to 6 Lakhs.
benefits: 50% tuition fee subsidy up to Rs 2 Lakhs per year + hostel allowance.
